description: Update a workspace's sandbox quotas and retention periods. Only the fields you pass change. Each quota has a matching clear_* flag to remove the override and fall back to the platform default; pass the value OR its clear flag, not both. There are no per-session defaults here — idle timeout and max duration are set per sandbox at creation.

clear_pause_retention.description: Remove the pause-retention override (use the platform default).

clear_snapshot_retention.description: Remove the snapshot-retention override, i.e. keep snapshots indefinitely.

max_preview_urls.description: Maximum preview URLs in the workspace.

max_total_bytes.description: Maximum combined snapshot + volume storage in bytes.

pause_retention_days.description: How long a paused sandbox's snapshot is kept before it becomes unresumable.

snapshot_retention_days.description: How long snapshots are kept before automatic cleanup.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to update. Omit to use the API key's first workspace.

name: tenki_update_workspace_settings
